title: A look at Chinese philosophical views on AI; one says aligning AI to human values may be a "suicidal mistake" and another fears the "machinization of humans" (Arnaud Bertrand)
summary: Arnaud Bertrand: A look at Chinese philosophical views on AI; one says aligning AI to human values may be a “suicidal mistake” and another fears the “machinization of humans” — We've been looking at AI from the bottom of our own well. Here's the view from China's. — ∙ Paid
contentText:
Arnaud Bertrand :

A look at Chinese philosophical views on AI; one says aligning AI to human values may be a “suicidal mistake” and another fears the “machinization of humans”   —  We've been looking at AI from the bottom of our own well.  Here's the view from China's.  —  ∙ Paid
